name: cinematic-field-recorder
title: Handheld cassette field recorder (cutscene desk prop)
usage: Broken Relay cutscenes: Teal's handheld recorder on the desk (recorder close-ups); the Lid part opens in chapter 25. Pending independent safety review (AGENTS.md); not uploaded. Dormant slot in src/: RobloxAssetIds entry undefined, so the cinematic keeps its procedural prop until approval and upload.

noText.note: No letters, numbers, level marks, codes or glyph-like marks: keys are plain cream and one plain red, the grilles are parallel slots, the door a smoked pane.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No maker's badge or brand marks; a plain worn grey case.

noRealMilitaryInsignia.note: No flags, roundels or markings; an original recorder layout, not a copy of any real product.

noFaces.note: No faces or figures. The top has one grille, a row of three keys, the cassette door and one small lamp in an irregular layout; the front end carries a single round microphone, the right side a single thumbwheel and the left side a single small jack, never a pair. Checked in preview-top, preview-front, preview-closeup-top and preview-closeup-front.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: Ordinary hard-surface recorder in every view.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: A tape recorder: no weapons, damage or gore.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.

orientation: Microphone end at Roblox -Z; the keys and lamp are on the model's left (Roblox -X), the grille and thumbwheel on its right (Roblox +X).
design: Original handheld cassette field recorder: worn grey metal case with rubber corner bumpers, a slotted speaker grille, three cream transport keys and a red record key, a smoked cassette door (Lid part) over the tape well hinged along its rear edge, a red tally lamp, one round microphone on the front end, a side thumbwheel and a jack.
sizeRationale: Body 2 x 1 x 3 studs, the procedural recorder box's envelope (the recorder close-up pose frames it). Anchors.Centre is the body centre (the procedural box's CFrame); anchors.Lamp is the lens top where the game keeps its blinking neon light. controlSurfaces.Lid is the door hinge: rotate the Lid part about it (positive angle about Roblox +X lifts the door) for chapter 25.
reviewStatus: pending independent safety review (AGENTS.md); not uploaded; dormant RobloxAssetIds slot (undefined) with procedural fallback
